SQL Tick marks not highlighting as a string **Information** - Language: SQL, MySQL - Plugins: none ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1571806/136258553-ac75e2f4-39da-4c7a-97e0-5e63fa19e0f1.png) **Description** When using ` marks to surround a keyword, the word should be formatted as a string. Adding a tick to this fixes the issue: ```javascript Prism.languages.sql = { 'string': { pattern: /(^|[^@\\])("|'|`)(?:\\[\s\S]|(?!\2)[^\\]|\2\2)*\2/, greedy: true, lookbehind: true }, } ```
The code being highlighted incorrectly. ```mysql select `t`.`col1`, `t`.`col2`, `t`.`col3`, `t`.`col4` from `test_table` as `t` ```
